data.source_formula_unit: C20 H24 N O19 P2 Zn3
data.hydrogen_refinement_context: Original CIF reports mixed hydrogen treatment;the graph and element composition alone do not assign missing protons or formal charges.

data.graph_convention: Use the standard moffragmentor finite-component model for this digital preprocessing audit:its default MOF constructor may replace the original CIF cell by a primitive cell;VestaCutoffDictNN defines connectivity. Finite components are not automatically neutral solvent.
data.review_policy: Flag every observed finite-component composition other than a complete H2O molecule for protonation/charge review before any proposed automatic all-guest deletion. This screen does not assign their charge or decide that a connected framework remains neutral. Do not add unobserved hydrogens to complete O-only components.
data.mass_counterfactual: Calculate only the fraction of modeled original-cell mass attributable to complete graph-identified H2O components. Use one consistent ordinary atomic-mass convention for the water and the full formula;the printed historical formula weight is not automatically the same convention. No isotope enrichment is requested.
data.scope: Original published crystallographic model with its actual atom/hydrogen completeness,used for a controlled simulation-input readiness audit. Finite-component detection is a graph convention,not proof of thermal removal,neutrality,physical activation stability or a prediction of experimental mass loss.

provenance.kind: authentic published crystallographic model with controlled digital preprocessing policy
provenance.generation: Lossless selected original published computational-data projection; no synthetic numerical observations. Source captures identify the original bytes. Any derived coordinate or format metadata is explicitly marked. These are computational inputs,not new experimental measurements.
provenance.units: Original and graph-cell volumes Å³;cell multiplicity dimensionless;ordinary mass units cancel in the water/full-formula mass fraction. Graph component counts must be placed on the original-cell basis before reporting.

source_capture.source_role: Original official package crystallographic test fixture;its embedded original-publication metadata remains raw. Not new or independently refined crystallography.
